info.name: Recognize AI
info.summary: High-performance Python + ONNX Runtime AI backend for Nextcloud media classification
info.description:
**Recognize AI** is a blazing-fast AI microservice providing:
- 🎯 **Object Detection** — YOLOv8n (80 COCO classes) - 👤 **Facial Recognition** — ArcFace (512-d embeddings) - 🔍 **Semantic Search** — CLIP ViT-B/32 (text-to-image queries)
Runs as a containerized ExApp with automatic GPU acceleration via ONNX Runtime. Includes an admin panel for model monitoring, GPU status, and a configurable background file scanner for automatic media classification.
info.author: pener
